description: Jotter saves what matters from one AI conversation so you never have to re-explain yourself in the next. Say 'jot this' and Jotter privately saves a note, or a handoff summary of the whole conversation. In a new chat later, or in a different AI assistant, say 'load my latest jot' and pick up where you left off, with your decisions, preferences, and next steps intact. You can also search your jots by keyword, list them, or delete them, right from the chat. Nothing is saved unless you ask, nothing ever auto-deletes, and your jots are private to you.

defaultPrompt: Jot this conversation so I can pick it up elsewhere
